author: santanumahata
body:
#### PR description:

In the 2023 HLT menus, both filters of `HLT_Diphoton30_18_R9IdL_AND_HE_AND_IsoCaloId_v*`
were renamed. Menus v1.0.x (runs 366403367619) use

- `hltEG30Iso60CaloId15b35eR9Id50b90eHE12b10eR9Id50b80eEcalIsoFilter`
- `hltEG18TrackIso60Iso60CaloId15b35eR9Id50b90eHE12b10eR9Id50b80eTrackIsoUnseededFilter`

and menus v1.1.0 to v1.2.3 (runs 367661370790) use

- `hltEG30Iso60b40eCaloId11b32eHE10b9eR9Id50b90eEcalIsoFilter`
- `hltDiEG18TrackIso60Iso60b40eCaloId11b32eHE10b9eR9Id50b90eTrackIsoUnseededFilter`

The photon `filterBits` in `triggerObjects_cff.py` only look for the old names, so for
2023 data taken with the new menus both Diphoton30_18 bits are never set.

This PR passes both names as a list to `mksel`, which ORs them into the same bit. The OR
never mixes two different selections: every 2023 menu of this path contains only one
name per leg (checked in the HLT menu browser).

The change is 3 lines in `PhysicsTools/NanoAOD/python/triggerObjects_cff.py`.
Bit numbers and the content of all other bits are unchanged.

Related: #52514 (accepts unseeded e/gamma objects in the Photon TrigObj selection).
The two are independent and touch different lines. The unseeded-leg (EG18) bit is
filled only with both.

Presentation at EGM General Meeting: [Slides](https://indico.cern.ch/event/1727819/contributions/7369346/attachments/3385956/6082421/Missing_unseeded_photon_filter_bits_in_NanoAOD_identification_and_fix_Santanu_Mahata.pdf)

@cms-sw/egamma-pog-l2 FYI
title: NanoAOD TrigObj: accept old and new 2023 Diphoton30_18 filter names in the photon bits
